decisions.reason: Turnaround management software has its own page, sits close to the core offer and is central to the announced data-driven airport direction, so visible commitment and sunk investment keep it firmly on the market.
The apron connectivity module underpins the integrated digital platform, and slow uptake can still be blamed on long airport project cycles, so management persists.
Equipment monitoring draws on the installed base and supports the expansion into lifecycle services, so it fits the announced direction and stays.
Apron resource management is close to the core offer and integral to the end-to-end operations suite, so sunk investment and strategic fit favour keeping it.
The controller safety alert service reinforces the firm's tower and safety positioning, and slow air traffic control adoption lets management treat weak early results as temporary.
